adjudication.rationale: In packages/lib/CalendarService.ts the base CalDAV/iCal creation path now destructures only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];`) and uses its `externalId` to filter the credential’s calendar list. With the diff changing `destinationCalendar` to an array and EventManager now iterating multiple destinations/credentials, this base service does not select the calendar corresponding to the *current* destination/credential; it always keys off the first destination’s externalId. For any later destination whose externalId differs (or doesn’t exist in that credential’s calendars), the `.filter(...)` can yield an empty list and no insert calls occur (`Promise.all` over an empty array). The finding’s downstream claim about “returns a success uid / reference saved” isn’t directly shown here, but the core defect (wrong filtering by first destination) is verifiable in the diff.
